source_request: Inspect CRM more in depth, identify all tables and minimum required fields, and build in Recognize; CRM module choices come afterward.

accepted_scope.crm: Read-only inventory, fields and layouts. No CRM module/field/record changes.
accepted_scope.change: Add six minimal tables and optional compatibility fields to the existing input tables. No renaming, deleting, importing legacy data or changing prototype routes.

acceptance.check: Current CRM inventory and required field/layout constraints recorded.
Only Recognize schema additions and this task's documentation change; CRM, engines, RingWaze and Webflow unchanged.
acceptance.evidence: actions, accepted_scope, limitations, rollback and associated report

acceptance.check: All 151 original field IDs, names, types and detailed configurations preserved.
Six new tables and each planned added field verified by live schema readback.
Synthetic records in new tables verify required data types, create/read/update and cleanup. No workflow or SMS proof claimed.
Document exact live table IDs, minimums, limitations and reversal; no additional phase.
acceptance.evidence: actions, accepted_scope, limitations, rollback and associated report

tables.name: rs_source_ids
tables.description: Lossless external identity mapping across WEC, WEF, legacy Airtable and future CRM. This is identity metadata, not engine data or a running synchronization. Minimum required: mapping_uid, entity_type, entity_uid, source_system, source_entity_type, source_scope, external_id, record_mode. Field descriptions identify conditional requirements. UID relationships are application references, not Airtable-enforced foreign keys.

fields.name: mapping_uid
fields.description: Required. Stable mapping UUID.

fields.name: entity_type
fields.description: Required. Kind of application entity referenced by entity_uid.

fields.name: entity_uid
fields.description: Required. Target application UID; not an Airtable record ID.

fields.name: source_system
fields.description: Required. Source provider/system, such as WEC, WEF, Zoho CRM or Legacy Airtable.

fields.name: source_entity_type
fields.description: Required. Source table/module/entity kind; separates rider IDs from trainer IDs.

fields.name: source_scope
fields.description: Required. Source account/base/venue namespace. Use an explicit global scope only if source IDs are globally unique.

fields.name: external_id
fields.description: Required. Original identifier preserved as text; no numeric conversion.

fields.name: record_mode
fields.description: Required for new records. Test records must never be used for live alerts. Blank existing values mean unclassified, not Live.

tables.name: rs_input_subscriptions
tables.description: User alert selections and consent state. No sending or automatic CRM synchronization is configured. Unknown consent never becomes Granted by migration. Minimum required: entity_uid, barn_uid, user_uid, engine_scope, target_type, target_uid, alert_types, status, consent_state, record_mode. User edits also retain owner/revision/request provenance where applicable. Field descriptions identify conditional requirements. UID relationships are application references, not Airtable-enforced foreign keys.

fields.name: entity_uid
fields.description: Required. Stable application UUID; preserve across CRM and Airtable. Do not use display names as identity.

fields.name: barn_uid
fields.description: Required. Barn scope for this subscription.

fields.name: user_uid
fields.description: Required. Recipient person from rs_input_users.entity_uid.

fields.name: engine_scope
fields.description: Required. One engine per subscription; engine rules stay separate.

fields.name: target_type
fields.description: Required. Defines which entity target_uid refers to.

fields.name: target_uid
fields.description: Required. Stable UID of the followed entity.

fields.name: alert_types
fields.description: Required before activation. Existing approved alert identifiers, one per line; no new trigger logic is defined here.

fields.name: phone_e164
fields.description: Required for active SMS. Normalized destination phone; never inferred from a name or phone suffix.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Required. Active additionally requires valid phone, Granted consent and source/time evidence; table storage alone does not enforce sending rules.

fields.name: consent_state
fields.description: Required. Record an actual user decision. Legacy active flags do not establish consent.

fields.name: consent_at
fields.description: Required when Granted or Revoked. Actual decision timestamp; do not fabricate migration timestamps.

fields.name: consent_source
fields.description: Required when Granted or Revoked. Form/event/source proving the decision.

fields.name: notice_version
fields.description: Required when the collection flow uses versioned notice text; preserve captured version.

fields.name: revoked_at
fields.description: Required after opt-out. Retain withdrawal; do not overwrite with stale CRM/mirror data.

fields.name: owner_uid
fields.description: Required on user-owned records. Existing application owner UID; not the Zoho staff Owner ID.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: Required on user changes. Positive revision; used for optimistic concurrency.

fields.name: request_uid
fields.description: Required on user changes. Stable request ID for retry/idempotency.

fields.name: request_hash
fields.description: Required on user changes. Hash of the request body; do not store credentials.

fields.name: record_mode
fields.description: Required for new records. Test records must never be used for live alerts. Blank existing values mean unclassified, not Live.

Minimum required: entity_uid, barn_uid, user_uid, engine_scope, target_type, target_uid, alert_types, status, consent_state, record_mode. User edits also retain owner/revision/request provenance where applicable. Field descriptions identify conditional requirements. UID relationships are application references, not Airtable-enforced foreign keys.

fields.name: entity_uid

fields.description: Required. Barn scope for this subscription.

fields.description: Required. One engine per subscription; engine rules stay separate.

fields.description: Required. Stable UID of the followed entity.

fields.name: alert_types

fields.name: consent_state

fields.name: consent_at
fields.description: Required when Granted or Revoked. Actual decision timestamp; do not fabricate migration timestamps.

fields.name: consent_source
fields.description: Required when Granted or Revoked. Form/event/source proving the decision.

fields.name: revoked_at
fields.description: Required after opt-out. Retain withdrawal; do not overwrite with stale CRM/mirror data.
